gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-linear-: Chunky, marker-bold lettering with round bowls that stay partly open. Noto Sans Linear A takes the quieter job, and its gaping c is the quality you notice first.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Comic Relief draws every stroke like a thick marker line, with no shift from heavy to light along a letter. Noto Sans Shavian is the sans-serif beneath, with loose curves that never knot up.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-ojuju: Approachable is the body's mood, and Ojuju backs it with wide s curves and thin strokes that never turn spindly. Comic Relief sits above it, stitched-thread strokes made for headings.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-pt-sans: Professional comfort comes from PT Sans, with its open arcs. Comic Relief above it looks like bent tubing, one gauge throughout, so a page of PT Sans text feels like a quiet reply to a loud heading.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-quattrocento-sans: Loud, round and slightly goofy, Comic Relief makes up and side strokes look identical, with no shift in thickness anywhere. Quattrocento Sans keeps its c from collapsing into an o.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-red-hat-text: Comic Relief brings a bold, commanding swagger, its bowls broken open and its strokes uniformly thick. And Red Hat Text follows in a sans-serif drawn with a technical pen's fine line, curvy and relaxed.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-rosario: Thin hairline joins are gone from Comic Relief, replaced by full-width stroke connections that give it a bold, blunt look. And Rosario's c ends never turn inward, which is the pair's most telling difference.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-ruluko: Comic Relief carries every stroke at the same visual weight, bold and commanding, with bowls that stay partly open. Ruluko's broad counters on c and s keep its sans-serif text approachable and clear.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-sarabun: Lines that hold their width through every turn define Comic Relief. Sarabun then reads clean and approachable, since every bowl gives the eye an easy way in over a long passage.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-sn-pro: Monoline and bold, with a blunt marker feel. Comic Relief is best at commanding attention, and SN Pro is best at quiet, modern sans text with open curves throughout.
